novel_features.name: Portfolio history
novel_features.description: Answer 'what was my portfolio worth on any given day' from a local time series Robinhood doesn't keep.
novel_features.rationale: The MCP has no portfolio-history endpoint; the CLI's append-only snapshot store is the only place this series exists.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Reach for this when a task needs portfolio value over time — no MCP tool can answer it.

novel_features.name: Guard — client-side trade policy
novel_features.description: Set per-trade caps, daily caps, symbol allow/denylists, and a kill switch that the CLI enforces before any order leaves the machine.
novel_features.rationale: Robinhood's OAuth scope is all-or-nothing and the platform ships no native limits, so enforceable guardrails can only live client-side.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use this before letting any agent loop place orders — it is the only enforceable budget/kill-switch layer for the agentic account.

novel_features.name: Order settle
novel_features.description: Resolve an order to verified terminal truth — actual fill price and state — instead of trusting the placement echo.
novel_features.rationale: Market-order price is null until backfilled and cancels return an acknowledgement that races the fill; settle polls past both.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Run after every place or cancel to get the real outcome, not the optimistic echo.

novel_features.name: Morning brief
novel_features.description: The whole pre-open check — portfolio value, day-over-day delta, open orders, positions, top movers among your holdings, and upcoming earnings for held symbols — in one command.
novel_features.rationale: Joins four MCP calls plus the local snapshot delta that no single tool provides.
novel_features.why_it_matters: The one-command replacement for the four-round-trip morning ritual.

novel_features.name: Mutation audit
novel_features.description: See everything the CLI (or an agent driving it) reviewed, placed, canceled, or was denied — with idempotency keys and outcomes.
novel_features.rationale: The server keeps no audit trail and watchlist writes can fail silently; the local write journal records every mutation attempt.
novel_features.why_it_matters: The weekly agent-accountability review: reconstruct exactly what an automation did.

novel_features.name: P&L win rate
novel_features.description: Round-trip win rate, average win/loss, and per-symbol stats computed from your synced trade history.
novel_features.rationale: Requires pairing trade-history rows into round trips locally — no API aggregation exists.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Journaling and strategy review without exporting to a spreadsheet.

novel_features.name: Surface diff
novel_features.description: Know when Robinhood adds, removes, or reshapes MCP tools — with dates — instead of discovering breakage in production.
novel_features.rationale: Requires historical tools/list snapshots that only the local store keeps; the surface churned 49→50 tools unannounced.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Check after any unexplained failure: the tool surface is beta and moves without notice.

novel_features.name: Wheel status
novel_features.description: Per-symbol wheel-strategy stage (cash-secured put → assigned → covered call → called away) inferred automatically.
novel_features.rationale: The MCP has no assignment/exercise history; the three-table local join and inference replace a manual weekly correlation.
novel_features.why_it_matters: The Friday post-expiration answer to 'what got assigned and what stage is each position in'.

narrative.headline: Every tool on Robinhood's official Agentic Trading MCP as a typed, review-first CLI — sanctioned OAuth instead of scraped tokens, plus an offline portfolio journal no Robinhood tool ships.
narrative.value_prop: Every other Robinhood tool rides the reverse-engineered private API with browser-lifted tokens that Robinhood periodically breaks. This CLI speaks the official agentic MCP surface: OAuth login with automatic refresh, server-side order simulation as the default dry-run, the undocumented tools (Level-2 books, financials, tax lots, scanner specs) surfaced as typed commands, and a local SQLite store that turns one-shot MCP calls into portfolio history, order audit trails, and offline search.
narrative.auth_narrative: First run: `auth login` self-registers a public OAuth client against Robinhood's dynamic-registration endpoint (no shipped secrets), opens your browser for the PKCE authorization on robinhood.com, catches the localhost callback, and stores access + refresh tokens in your config with automatic refresh (~4-day access tokens). `auth status` shows expiry; `ROBINHOOD_AGENTIC_TOKEN` overrides for CI. Reads and `review` (server-side order simulation) are always allowed. Order placement and cancellation, watchlist writes, and scan writes are blocked at the transport unless `ROBINHOOD_AGENTIC_PP_ALLOW_WRITES=1` is set — the hard floor that keeps read-only testing safe by construction. On top of that gate, the `guard` policy adds per-order and daily notional caps, a symbol allow/denylist, and a kill switch, all enforced locally before any order leaves the machine, and every mutation is recorded to the local write journal (`audit`). Recommended flow: `equities review` first, then set the write gate to place for real.

quickstart.comment: One-time OAuth: self-registers a client, opens the browser, stores refresh-capable tokens
See your accounts and which one is agentic_allowed (the only one that can place agent orders)
Real-time quotes with official prior close (max 20 symbols per call)
Pull positions, orders, watchlists, and P&L into the local SQLite store

quickstart.command: robinhood-agentic-pp-cli equities review --account <account> --symbol AAPL --side buy --type limit --quantity 1 --limit-price 180
quickstart.comment: Server-side order simulation — Robinhood's own pre-trade warnings, nothing placed

troubleshoots.fix: Run `auth login` (tokens expire after ~4 days without refresh; `auth status` shows expiry)

troubleshoots.symptom: Order rejected with a time-in-force error
troubleshoots.fix: Robinhood's MCP accepts only `--tif gfd` or `--tif gtc` — the classic `day` value is rejected server-side

troubleshoots.symptom: portfolio realized-pnl fails with a missing-parameter error
troubleshoots.fix: Pass `--asset-classes equity,option` — the live service requires it despite docs marking it optional, and use the RHS account number from `accounts list`
Only the dedicated Agentic account (agentic_allowed=true in `accounts list`) can place orders; reads work on every account
Robinhood publishes no rate limits; the CLI backs off adaptively — re-run `doctor --json` to see limiter state

narrative.when_to_use: Reach for this CLI whenever a task touches a real Robinhood account through the official agentic surface: checking portfolio state, quoting and screening symbols, reviewing or auditing orders, managing watchlists, or running server-side scanners. It is the safe default for agent-driven Robinhood work — reads span all accounts, writes are triple-gated (env + flag + review-first), and everything returns agent-shaped JSON. Do not use it for crypto trading, ACH transfers, or multi-leg options: the official MCP does not expose those surfaces.
